N=1000
OUT_FILE=/tmp/burger-fifo.json
EP=$(sed -n 's#.*<endpoint>\(tcp://[^<]*\)</endpoint>.*#\1#p' /etc/sceptre/config.xml | tail -1)
if [ -z "$EP" ]; then
  RC=2; OUT='no provider endpoint in /etc/sceptre/config.xml'
else
  TAG=$(seq 1 $N | sed 's/^/burgerfifo/;s/$/:0/' | paste -sd, - | sed 's/:0$//')
  # the probe appends ":0" to the last tag; retry while the provider is not up yet
  for TRY in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
    OUT=$(timeout 60 bennu-probe --endpoint "$EP" --command write --tag "$TAG" --value 0 2>&1); RC=$?
    [ $RC -eq 0 ] && break
    case "$OUT" in *offline*) sleep 10 ;; *) break ;; esac
  done
fi
ESC=$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | tr '\n\t' '  ' | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')
printf '{"tags": %s, "rc": %s, "reply": "%s"}\n' "$N" "$RC" "$ESC" > $OUT_FILE
cat $OUT_FILE
